Subject: RE: Aligning on MAP & eval cadence for Orbit launch

Hi Tessa / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to get the Mutual Action Plan locked and kick off the evaluation window next week so we can hit our internal procurement and go-live dates by end of September.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can we schedule a 45-min MAP kickoff this week to agree on owners and timelines?
- We’ll share a draft MAP and our success criteria (attached). Can your team own the model-ops evaluation checkpoints?

Attached: Orbit_MAP_Draft_v0.9.pdf

Preferred times (PDT): Wed 8/4 10:00-11:00, Thu 8/5 14:00-15:00.

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Ava Summers
Program Lead, Partnerships
Orbit Systems

Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00

Thanks, Ava — great to see the draft. I put a tentative 45-min calendar hold for Wed 8/4 10:00 PDT (see invite) so we can align owners and the evaluation window. Ben, can you bring the ops/runbook perspective and confirm the Zoom link?

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & objectives (5)
2) MAP walkthrough and success criteria (10)
3) Roles & owners for evaluations (10)
4) Evaluation schedule & gating (10)
5) Next steps & close timeline (10)

Attachments: eval-schedule-templates.xlsx (we’ll tailor during the call).

If that slot doesn’t work, we can move to Thu 8/5 14:00. Ava/Leo — please confirm attendees and any other stakeholders we should loop in (security / procurement).

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Ava Summers (Program Lead)
